This final target, Islandicin 4-Methyl Ether, is implicated in affecting Hepatocyte function. The integrated explanation highlights a possible mechanism where Dofequidar indirectly influences Hepatocyte activity via its interaction with Macrophage scavenger receptors, which in turn are targeted by Islandicin 4-Methyl Ether. This pathway underscores a complex interplay between immune system components and cellular targets, suggesting that Dofequidar may exert its effects on Hepatocyte function through a non-direct route. The evidence supports a role for Dofequidar in modulating Hepatocyte activity, though the exact nature of this modulation remains to be fully elucidated.
